findings.mechanism: The exact HFT trace links focus completion and inscription to the seventh and eighth verses' action, measure, minute-scale, good, evil, and seeing coordinates. Record, exact measure, polarity, and visible retrieval contact to produce an exhaustive accounting image.
findings.reader_payoff: The atom-sized comparison becomes procedural: even the smallest trace is imagined as retained and returned through a complete disclosure system.
findings.containment: The ordinary moral weighing and seeing remain primary. The protocol and earth commission are attributed HFT inferences; unresolved branches contribute only their named roles.

epistemic.reason: The exact HFT trace covers both moral polarities and returns through the focus, but its protocol synthesis is legacy_unbound attributed evidence.

findings.title: Sudden maturation into disclosure
findings.claim: As a contained material analogy, the focus command rapidly raises and matures the earth into its final disclosure-state, compressing gradual nurture into sudden upheaval.
findings.mechanism: The exact HFT outlier links non-dominant increase and nurture branches at the focus lordship carrier to the focus speed branch, quake, and soft-earth context. Gradual raising meets sudden shaking and produces a compressed maturation image.
findings.reader_payoff: The transition from quake to disclosure can be felt as a sudden completion: a long-held earth reaches the state in which it can release what it carries.
findings.containment: This is exploratory attributed evidence and does not replace ordinary syntax or the dominant ر ب ب root. The non-dominant split-root mapping, soft-earth image, and rapid-raising relation remain explicitly qualified.

epistemic.reason: The exact outlier trace supplies matching focus and 99:1 coordinates but marks the split-root analogy exploratory under legacy_unbound provenance.

findings.title: An affective overtone in the earth's report
findings.claim: With careful qualification, the commanded testimony can carry the overtone of a lament released together with the earth's burdens.
findings.mechanism: The exact HFT outlier links the focus crying branch to the earth's extraction and later renewed report, while heavy burdens supply the affective weight. The focus communication is therefore attributed as permitting testimony to sound burdened as well as factual.
findings.reader_payoff: The earth's report can be heard with emotional pressure: disclosure is not only an inventory but may carry the weight of what had been held.
findings.containment: Mourning is a remote branch in this verbal setting and remains an affective overtone, not a literal claim that the earth cries. The ordinary burdens and reports remain primary.

epistemic.reason: The exact outlier supplies matching 99:2, 99:4, and 99:5 coordinates and an explicit containment warning; the lament relation remains exploratory attributed evidence.
